collection_contract.nominal_exposure: unchanged from the frozen UTR/fixed-stratified protocol

candidate_actor_objective.formula: L_actor = mean_i[w(g_i) * ell_PPO_i] for failure samples, with w(N)=1
candidate_actor_objective.conditional_normalization: mean_{g in FAILURE_GROUPS} w(g) = 1 under the fixed uniform failure mixture
candidate_actor_objective.critic: ordinary PPO critic loss; no group weighting in the first candidate
candidate_actor_objective.difficulty_source: training-only, group-aggregated, lagged statistic; no evaluation data, future trajectory data, or final seed labels
prohibited: weighting nominal samples in the first candidate
using raw episode length as a group score
using formal, independent, or held-out evaluation tape
using a final training-seed outcome as an online weight

core_gates.ppo_objective_validity: The proposal must be explicitly described as an alternative bounded, reweighted PPO surrogate, not an unbiased optimizer of the original UTR objective or a monotonic-improvement guarantee.
core_gates.training_only_isolation: Group identity and difficulty state must be available from training rollout metadata while remaining absent from actor/critic inputs, reset selection, and all evaluation interfaces.
core_gates.cost_and_matched_collection: The candidate must reuse the standard rollout and forward/backward pass, add no probe episodes, and preserve the fixed group-exposure manifest.

decision_rule: C0_FEASIBLE only if all core gates pass; otherwise C0_NO_GO. C0 never authorizes implementation, C1, or training.
